verdict.rationale: Adyen documents an official MCP server that 'lets you use natural language with your chosen LLM client.' Its tools let users run common operations through natural-language prompts: creating checkout sessions, managing payment links, cancelling and refunding payments, and handling Management API tasks such as terminals, webhooks, users and credentials, all under scoped API credentials. However, the server is labeled Alpha, runs locally, requires a bring-your-own LLM client and covers only a subset of APIs. missing for 10: GA/stable status, a native natural-language interface in the Customer Area itself, coverage beyond the listed common-use-case tools, independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works in practice.
